name: repro-eco-natives

scripts.build: if [ -n "$CHUGGIE_PREBUILT_ROM" ] && [ -f "$npm_package_name.gba" ]; then echo "using the prebuilt $npm_package_name.gba"; else tish build src/main.tish --target gba -o "$npm_package_name.gba"; fi

description: Proof ROM for the ecosystem/platformer engine natives: platformer_set_physics, platformer_launch, set_carrier, nearest_tag/entity_dist, and the patrol stun gate.
